synthesis.body: `refs/stash` lives in the common git dir, so every linked worktree (git worktree, Conductor workspace, any parallel-agent setup on one clone) pushes to and pops from the same stack. A concurrent rebase elsewhere will pop your stash into its tree, and your pop will land its untracked files in yours — which then fail your repo's own linters for reasons that look unrelated. Park work with a local commit (`git commit`, later `git reset --soft HEAD~1`) instead; commits are per-worktree. Recovery: `git log --all --format='%H %s' | grep <marker>` (not `git fsck --unreachable`, too slow on a large repo); a stash commit has three parents, and the untracked files are in the third.

title: git stash is shared across worktrees — never park work with it when agents run in parallel
